provenance: Rendered manual from the exact [PostgreSQL 18.6 documentation release archive](https://apt.postgresql.org/pub/latest/postgresql-18.6-docs.tar.gz). The [REL_18_6 copyright notice](https://github.com/postgres/postgres/blob/REL_18_6/COPYRIGHT) permits redistribution of the documentation. The per-page links use the publisher's PostgreSQL 18 documentation URLs, which may track a later 18.x patch online.
coverage: Complete English HTML manual for 18.6, including the tutorial, SQL language, administration, interfaces, tools, extensions, and release notes.
omissions: Separate PDF and duplicate man page formats are outside the searchable snapshot.
